Here’s a tip about <$cdef(27)>Dream Islands</color>!

You probably know that <$cdef(27)>Drifloon will take you to a
<$cdef(27)>Dream Island if you show them a <$cdef(27)>doll...
But if you’ve ever wondered, “Where IS <$cdef(27)>Drifloon anyway?”
or thought, “They’re too far away!” then this tip is for you!

You can just plop a <$cdef(27)>doll down anywhere you like, and
when you talk to it...
Surprise! <$cdef(27)>Drifloon will come floating over to greet you!

Furthermore, the island you’ll be taken to depends on
what kind of <$cdef(27)>doll you use.

If you’re desperate to go to a <$cdef(27)>Dream Island for materials,
but <$cdef(27)>Drifloon is nowhere nearby...
We hope you remember this helpful tip!
